description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Circle of Dreams Druid.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Circle of Dreams Druid.
Repeat.
